reason: NONE. The first thing I noticed was the "Every batch lab-tested" line with the QR code, which I like, but I already have a magnesium on auto-ship that works and I have tried three brands this year, so I am not adding a fourth with zero reviews.
objection: A brand with no reviews and a price of about $1 a serving. I compare price per serving and I can get bisglycinate for less from brands with hundreds of reviews. A QR code does not tell me how it feels after a month.
